question: In github.com/payloadcms/payload's local (email/password) auth strategy, trace how a password is stored at registration versus how it is checked at login: which file derives and stores the hash+salt, which file verifies a submitted password against the stored hash, what key-derivation function and parameters are used, and how the comparison avoids a timing side-channel? Name the files at each hop.
critical_facts: hashing/storage happens in packages/payload/src/auth/strategies/local/generatePasswordSaltHash.ts: it generates a 32-byte random salt and derives the hash with crypto.pbkdf2 using 25000 iterations, keylen 512, digest 'sha256', returning { hash, salt }

verification happens in packages/payload/src/auth/strategies/local/authenticate.ts (authenticateLocalStrategy): it re-derives crypto.pbkdf2(password, salt, 25000, 512, 'sha256') with the SAME parameters and compares against the stored hash
the comparison uses crypto.timingSafeEqual (after a length check) to avoid a timing side-channel, rather than a plain === / Buffer equality
the two files must agree on identical pbkdf2 parameters (25000/512/sha256) or verification would never match
material_errors: claims payload uses bcrypt/argon2/scrypt instead of pbkdf2 (it is crypto.pbkdf2)
claims the login comparison uses a plain string/=== comparison rather than crypto.timingSafeEqual
names only one of the two files, or attributes hashing to authenticate.ts / verification to generatePasswordSaltHash.ts (they are swapped)
cites the test file authenticate.spec.ts (which uses pbkdf2Sync to fabricate a fixture) as the production hashing implementation
evidence: packages/payload/src/auth/strategies/local/authenticate.ts:19 — `crypto.pbkdf2(password, salt, 25000, 512, 'sha256', ...)`; :26-31 `crypto.timingSafeEqual(hashBuffer, storedHashBuffer)` after a length check; :13 `export const authenticateLocalStrategy`
call sites: generatePasswordSaltHash invoked from auth/strategies/local/register.ts:81 and auth/operations/resetPassword.ts:99; authenticateLocalStrategy invoked from auth/operations/login.ts:222
burden: `git grep -n "pbkdf2" -- packages/payload/src` = 5 lines across 3 files (the two source files plus the spec fixture)
